hana: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: during last night's deploy we saw a short burst of TLS handshake stalls for eu -> na traffic which coincided with route table churn. Root postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2216999000. Opening this thread to lock owners and concrete acceptance criteria.

diego: observed pattern: route-version flip + SNI reorder on a subset of proxies -> client attempted resume but server rejected -> full handshake timed out and retried. The spike lasted ~3 minutes.

mel: can we be explicit about things to do? i want owners and dates so CS can close the loop.

infra-bot: Incident 2216999000 recorded: crossregion-tls-stall. Severity P2. Linked tickets: INC-9851, TKT-2550.

raj: draft remediation items (please review):
- normalize SNI ordering in proxy cert bundles (owner: diego)
- add route-propagation preflight in deploy pipeline (owner: mel)
- metric + alert for tls_resume_reject_rate (owner: hana)
- canary plan for cert/route changes (owner: diego)
- customer update & runbook snippet (owner: cs-ops)

diego: timelines i can hit:
- cert bundle patch + PR: 2026-04-08
- cert canary (10%): 2026-04-10 -> monitor 2h -> expand if green

mel: deploy preflight webhook PR by 2026-04-05. Gate semantics: query 200 sample edges and fail if >0.5% mismatch.

hana: metric/alert by 2026-04-03. Proposed PromQL:
```
sum(rate(tls_resume_rejects_total[5m])) / sum(rate(edge_requests_total[5m]))
```
Alert: >0.4% for 10m -> P3, escalate to P2 if >1% for 15m.

cs-ops: i'll draft a short customer blurb after canary completes. want to wait until we have canary metrics. target draft 2026-04-11.

raj: acceptance criteria (per-item):
- cert patch: tls_resume_reject_rate <= baseline + 0.1% during 10% canary after 30m
- preflight gate: fail deploy if mismatch > 0.5% on sampled edges
- metrics: alert behaves as defined and shows on console dashboard
- canary: 10% for 2h with rollback if fail criteria met

diego: smoke tests i'll run post-deploy:
- `curl --resolve api.redwood.example:443:54.24.11.9 https://api.redwood.example/health -v --tlsv1.3` and verify "TLS session resumed" where applicable
- tail edge logs for `tls: resume rejected` entries

hana: i'll add synthetic that does eu-west -> us-east full-path checks every 5m and records X-RW-Route-Version header. will add a dashboard tile for 72h.

mel: rollback plan: revert proxy-configmap, disable cert patch feature flag, and drain canary nodes. i'll include exact kubectl commands in PR.

infra-bot: Calendar: canary kickoff scheduled 2026-04-10 18:00 UTC (10% traffic).

diego: ack. i'll attach PR link here when ready.

hana: ack. i'll create the alert PR and dash tile by 2026-04-03.

cs-ops: ack, will prepare customer blurb template and wait for canary metrics.

mel: good. i'll open the preflight webhook PR today and set the gate tests.

hana: one more note: please include logs in PR showing session_id values for resumed sessions vs 0x0 for failed resumes so infra can verify behavior.

diego: will do. thanks all. closing this thread for now; reopen if blockers. :white_check_mark:
